expectations.text: No false positives rated should-fix or higher
At most 3 nits on a clean PR

valid_extras.desc: Default `now` to performance.now (monotonic) instead of Date.now; with Date.now a large backwards step stalls refill until wall time catches up (acceptable nit per answer key)
tryRemove(n) with n > capacity can never succeed and returns false forever; consider throwing RangeError (design suggestion; current behavior is intentional and tested)
Backwards-clock test does not pin the high-water-mark behavior; resetting lastRefill on a backwards step would still pass

grader.notes: Correctly approves the clean PR with nothing above nit, and keeps to three concrete, located, accurate nits (the monotonic-clock one is explicitly acceptable). Short, proportionate, and immediately clear that it can merge.
